## mywienerlinien — Vienna Transit MCP
Before starting work: query the MCP tools `next_departures` + `traffic_alerts` for the stop/line in question (never hardcode departures). Backend API: http://127.0.0.1:11170 (`GET /api/health`). Dashboard: web_sota/src (Vite 10896). At end of work: `uv run ruff check src/` clean and note DB migrations in CHANGELOG.md.
